title: Notification regarding the Skill Test-1 of Technical Assistant, the fonts available for Meitei Mayek script typing in MS Word shall be restricted to either Epaomayek or Kanglei .
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
THE HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphat, the 2CP January, 2025
No. HCM/D-42/2023-Estt.-1/47’£' : in addition to this Registry’s Notification
of even no. dated 18th January, 2025, it is hereby informed to all concerned that for the
Skill Test - 1 of Technical Assistant, the fonts available for Meitei Mayek script typing in
MS Word shall be restricted to either epaomayek or Kanglei.
L* hm
(REETA LAISHRAM)
LANGUAGE OFFICER (SPECIAL OFFICER)
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Copy to: -
1. The Principal Secretary to Hon’ble The Chief Justice, High Court of Manipur.
2. The Private Secretary to Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh, Judge, High Court of Manipur.
3. The Private Secretary to Hon’ble Mr. Justice A, Guneshwar Sharma, Judge, High Court of
Manipur.
4. The Private Secretary to Hon’ble Mrs. Justice Golmei Gaiphulsillu, Judge, High Court of
Manipur.
5. The Registrar General, High Court of Manipur.
6. Jhe Jt. Registrar (Judt.)/CPC, High Court of Manipur.
\Z The System Analyst, High Court of Manipur.
